intro: Badminton is Malaysia's favourite sport, and it has given the country most of its Olympic medals.

chapters.title: Badminton
text: Malaysia has won the Thomas Cup, the world team championship, five times. Lee Chong Wei was world No. 1 for over 300 weeks and won three Olympic silvers.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Football, field hockey and sepak takraw are popular. Diver Pandelela Rinong won Olympic medals, and Nicol David was world No. 1 in squash for 109 months in a row. Sepang hosted Formula One from 1999 to 2017 and still hosts MotoGP.
